author: Inside Edition
description: The mysterious disappearance of Savannah Guthrie's mother, Nancy, has turned attention to just how secure are the homes of senior citizens. Senior citizens are especially vulnerable to break-ins or other criminal acts, but experts say there are certain things that should be in place to add an extra layer of security to their homes. Security expert Kathleen Gallegher gave Inside Edition to help elderly folks secure their homes.
title: Tips To Help The Elderly Secure Their Homes

author: Inside Edition
description: Inside Edition's Alison Hall boarded a chopper and headed to the sky with officers keeping the Super Bowl safe. On the big game day, Black Hawk choppers will be in the air watching for suspicious activity and a 10-mile no fly zone will be enforced, which includes drones. The Coast Guard will be watching over the game from the sea, and bomb sniffing dogs will be on patrol. More than 50 federal, state, and local law enforcement organizations will be on hand.
title: Security Measures Heightened For Sunday's Super Bowl

author: Inside Edition
description: An elderly man learned he will spend the rest of his life in prison after being convicted of murder in the fatal shooting of an innocent Uber driver. Video from the Uber driver's dash cam captured the killing from two years ago. It showed 81-year-old William Brock pointing a gun at 61-year-old Lo-Letha Hall. Brock told police that a scammer had called him threatening his family. At the same time, Hall was told to pick up a package at Brock's home. Hall's only son testified at Brock's sentencing.
title: Man, 83, Sentenced To Life In Prison For Murder Of Uber Driver

author: Inside Edition
description: The new series "Love Story," features John F. Kennedy Jr. and Carolyn Bessette. The Ryan Murphy limited series, airing on FX and Hulu depicts the moment they met and their ups and downs. Newcomer Paul Kelly plays JFK Jr. and actress Sarah Pidgeon plays Bessette. The stars posed on the red carpet Tuesday night at the premiere in New York City. The love story of one of the most photographed couples in history is being retold in time for Valentine's Day.
title: 'Love Story' Explores JFK Jr And Carolyn Bessette's Relationship

author: Inside Edition
description: Police are working to trace the source of the ransom note demanding millions of dollars in Bitcoin for the return of Savannah Guthrie's mom, Nancy. The email was sent to a local TV station in Tucson and turned over to police. It detailed what Nancy Guthrie was wearing when she was kidnapped and gave specific information about the interior of her house. The White House tells Inside Edition that President Donald Trump has reached out to Savannah Guthrie.
title: Authorities Probe Alleged Ransom Note For Nancy Guthrie Kidnapping

author: Inside Edition
description: President Donald Trump lashed out at CNN anchor Kaitlan Collins as she peppered him with uncomfortable questions about Jeffrey Epstein. "I don't think I've ever seen you smile," Trump said. Even when the press conference was over, he didn't let it go. The blow-up has sparked plenty of reaction Wednesday. On her CNN show Tuesday night, Collins told her audience the Epstein scandal is nothing to smile about.
title: Outrage After President Trump Lashes Out At CNN's Kaitlan Collins

author: Inside Edition
description: Inside Edition spoke to several Super Bowl-bound players about the people that inspired them.
title: Whom Did These Super Bowl Players Think Of First? #shorts

description: Flight attendant Meredith Sanders had a particular interest in the trial of Brendan Banfield, because she says she was close friends with the murder victim.
title: Friend Of Murder Victim Christine Banfield Speaks Out #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: Call it a "bear's-eye" view. Researchers at Washington State University released video they collected after attaching cameras to 12 grizzly bears in Alaska's North Slope. They wanted to see how the bears survive during the 8 months they're not in hibernation. They found that the bears are not only surviving, but thriving. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: What Researchers Found When 12 Grizzly Bears Wore Cameras For Months

author: Inside Edition
description: The stunned "Daily Show" host said his name appeared in an email sent from a Hollywood producer to Jeffrey Epstein, suggesting Stewart as the host for a potential TV special on Woody Allen.
title: Why Did Jon Stewart's Name Appear In Epstein Files? #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: This driver had a rough night, but at least his rescue crew was friendly. The Charlotte Fire Department was called to help a man who ended up standing in the bed of his pickup truck in the middle of a pond. A team was sent to get him in a raft, and after fitting him with a life jacket, he was brought aboard while they were all pulled back to shore. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Man Rescued After Driving Into Frozen Pond In North Carolina
